args.description: taps the invisible opponent he is holding with the pommel of a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged: a small short motion of the hilt, then back to holding. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of him with both hands
